scope: Completed public brain logs and frozen Git source only; no truth, layout, record, driver metadata, network, or robot calls. Observation-side audit only, not an official PASS or proof of physical identity.

formulas.pick_alignment: distance_cm=100*hypot(original confirmed position-current odometry); use exact identified fresh detection bearing if available; distance<=22.5, abs(bearing)<=3
formulas.pick_old_position_absence: After five recorded backward6cm steps with holding retained, count same-category detections with position within strict 0.15m of original confirmed position
formulas.place_ellipse: bx=ball.x+ball.w/2; by=ball.y+ball.h; q=((bx-zone.x-zone.w/2)/(zone.w/2))^2+((by-zone.y-zone.h/2)/(zone.h/2))^2; q<=0.64 with original complete-region/w,h>=3 checks
formulas.place_unique: All current red-ball × current green-region pairs; exclude known-delivered and original preexisting IDs; one eligible pair; empty gripper; same frame and original release boundary
formulas.release_fixed_alignment: distance=100*hypot(fixed point-current odometry); bearing=wrap(current.headingDeg-heading_to(current,fixed point)); distance<=19cm and abs(bearing)<=3deg

alignment_recomputed.projection_limit: The logged calibration-derived ground point is used; camera calibration is outside these five inputs, so projection itself is not independently rerun.
